requests.recipient: District Clerk, Sunset Beach Sanitary District
requests.subject: Request for four named adopted District instruments
requests.body:
Please provide electronic copies of the following adopted instruments:

1. The amendment to Article V of Ordinance 22-01 adopted January 11, 2024, effective March 1, 2024, unchanged from the December 2023 first reading.
2. Resolution 2024-03-01 adopted March 14, 2024, setting trash, sewer and restaurant sewage-cleaning fees.
3. Resolution 2024-02-01 adopted February 8, 2024, approving physical-space waivers, including any attached general eligibility or operating conditions. Individual property inspection photographs, applications and personal information are not requested.
4. Resolution 2026-06-01 adopted June 11, 2026, accepting the 2026–27 assessment roll, including any general assessment conditions or amendments. The individual parcel assessment roster is not requested.

I have the published adoption minutes. These requests concern the adopted instrument text referenced by those minutes. Existing electronic copies or direct public download links are sufficient.

requests.recipient: City Clerk, City of Huntington Beach
requests.subject: 2025 HOME TBRA agreements — incorporated Exhibit A
requests.body:
Please provide Exhibit A, including the incorporated TBRA Program Operating Guidelines and their referenced appendices/forms, for the July 1, 2025 HOME Subrecipient Agreements with Families Forward and Mercy House. The publicly posted agreement records are Laserfiche 7236879 (Families Forward) and 7236885 (Mercy House); their scans contain the contract and insurance pages but omit Exhibit A.

If these agreements incorporate an existing guideline edition rather than a new 2025 edition, please provide the incorporated edition and the existing record identifying that incorporation. This request is limited to those two agreements’ incorporated program instruments; it does not request individual tenant contracts, applications or participant records. Existing electronic copies or direct public download links are sufficient.
